note: Triennial election of the rural district council, 1933: nominations received by W. Calvert, clerk, 25 April 1933. The Armagh Guardian list has no entry for Richhill and includes a "Keady—Thomas Mallon, J.P. (N.)" line that appears to belong to the county council list, so neither is filed here. Returned unopposed. Labelled "F." (a Fruit Growers' supporter); John Halligan was not renominated.
